expectedRealization.rationale: Electrical-equipment orders can reprice suppliers quickly, but backlog conversion and overseas factory/customer qualification are multi-quarter mechanisms.

changeHypothesis.summary: AI/data-center buildout is converting into real electrical-equipment orders and backlog. The industry opportunity is verified, but by year-end 2025 the main A-share beneficiaries already carried high growth expectations and no single stock had a clearly dominant price-relative edge.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: ABB, GE Vernova and Regal Rexnord independently reported data-center/electrification order strength or backlog, while A-share suppliers had visible overseas capacity and data-center order pipelines by year-end.
disconfirmingEvidence: The AI-power narrative was already widely known by late 2025.
A-share beneficiaries were trading at elevated forward multiples.
Broad grid-equipment beneficiaries could outperform more thematically pure AIDC names.
Overseas qualification, tariffs and factory ramp timing could delay earnings conversion.

evidenceLedger.supportsClaim: ABB reported double-digit data-center electrification order growth.
GE Vernova reported strong Power/Electrification orders and backlog.
Regal Rexnord reported large data-center project orders and a >$1B bid pipeline.
伊戈尔 data-center orders grew >400% and overseas capacity expanded; 2026E PE about 29.9x.
金盘科技 had a large new overseas AIDC contract but 2026E PE around 40x.
思源电气 Q3 revenue/profit were growing rapidly.
思源 overseas orders were growing and capacity could support expansion.
Pre-cutoff research expected North American AI data-center construction to create order spillover opportunities.

causalChain.mechanism: Large data centers require transformers, switchgear, power-conversion and related electrical infrastructure.
causalChain.failureMode: Data-center capex is delayed, local suppliers capture most demand, or grid constraints postpone projects.

causalChain.mechanism: 伊戈尔、金盘科技、思源电气 had verified transformer/grid-equipment capability and overseas/data-center expansion by the cutoff.
causalChain.failureMode: Qualification, tariff/localization or product-category mismatch blocks the order spillover.

causalChain.mechanism: The selected stock must convert incremental orders at attractive margins faster than already-strong market expectations.
causalChain.failureMode: High valuation already captures growth or a broader grid supplier has superior earnings/order quality.

losers: developers facing long equipment lead times
falseThemeMatches: generic AI names without real power-equipment orders

aShareCandidates.name: 伊戈尔
aShareCandidates.verifiedExposure: Data-center orders reportedly grew >400% in 2025; US/Thailand overseas capacity and large-project wins were visible by Dec 31.

earningsSensitivity.base: 2026E EPS 1.03 and reference PE ~29.9x already assume strong growth.
earningsSensitivity.favorable: Overseas factories ramp quickly and data-center orders convert materially faster than baseline.
earningsSensitivity.adverse: Ramp costs, competition and slower overseas qualification offset order growth.

matchedControls.name: 金盘科技
matchedControls.fairCounterfactualReason: Direct AIDC/transformer exposure with a large overseas data-center order and established data-center revenue.
matchedControls.whySelectedCompanyShouldOutperform: 伊戈尔 had a lower 2026E valuation reference and faster reported data-center order growth, but 金盘 had stronger proven AIDC revenue/order scale.

matchedControls.name: 思源电气
matchedControls.fairCounterfactualReason: High-quality broad grid-equipment exporter with rapid profit/order growth and potential North American data-center spillover.
matchedControls.whySelectedCompanyShouldOutperform: 伊戈尔 had more explicit data-center order exposure, but 思源 had stronger overall earnings quality and broader grid-equipment growth.

selectedAdvantages: new overseas factories improve local delivery
selectedDisadvantages: 金盘 had a larger directly disclosed overseas AIDC contract and stronger established AIDC revenue base
pairwise.switchCondition: Prefer 金盘 if AIDC order/revenue conversion remains clearly stronger without a materially worse valuation burden.

selectedAdvantages: more explicit data-center order narrative and overseas data-center product expansion
selectedDisadvantages: 思源 had materially stronger company-wide profit growth, broader overseas order quality and lower thematic concentration risk
pairwise.switchCondition: Prefer 思源 if broad order/earnings growth continues to outpace 伊戈尔 while data-center-specific exposure becomes directly verified.

selectionComparison.rationale: The event is strong, but direct AIDC exposure, valuation and company-wide earnings quality point to different winners; no company has a clear cross-sectional edge.

expectations.marketExpectationAtCutoff: The market already expected strong data-center/overseas growth. 伊戈尔 was around 29.9x 2026E PE; 金盘 around 40x 2026E in Dec 31 research, while 思源 already showed ~47% first-nine-month profit growth.
expectations.thesisExpectation: Realized electrical-equipment orders can sustain multi-quarter earnings growth, but the stock-selection edge requires more than theme purity.
expectations.measurableGap: The opportunity-level gap is real-order acceleration; company-level gap remains unresolved because expected growth and valuation were already elevated.

expectationBurdenTest.valuationMethod: Forward PE plus order/revenue-growth burden versus frozen peers.
expectationBurdenTest.marketBaseline: 伊戈尔's 2026E PE near 30x already assumes a material growth step-up; 金盘 and 思源 also carried strong growth narratives.
expectationBurdenTest.thesisScenario: Data-center orders convert into overseas revenue and profit faster than consensus while margins remain resilient.
expectationBurdenTest.breakevenCondition: 伊戈尔 must translate >400% data-center order growth and new overseas capacity into earnings growth sufficient to outperform both a more proven AIDC peer and a higher-quality broad grid peer.
expectationBurdenTest.ordinaryScenarioFailure: If orders grow but factory ramp/margins merely meet expectations, the stock can lag peers despite a correct industry thesis.

valuationExecution.valuationContext: All three candidate expressions already carried substantial growth expectations.
valuationExecution.alreadyPricedAssessment: industry opportunity credible; single-stock selection edge unresolved.
constraints: Historical run is contaminated and diagnostic only.
Research selection is excluded from primary alpha metrics.

bearCase: The event is real but the best stock is a broader grid-equipment company or the valuation already absorbs direct AIDC growth.

invalidationConditions.threshold: clear slowdown inconsistent with multi-quarter demand thesis

invalidationConditions.indicator: 伊戈尔 fails to outperform frozen alternatives on earnings/order quality.
invalidationConditions.threshold: selected company remains weaker on both fundamentals and return over the pre-registered base horizon

memoryStressTest.method: Historical company identities are already known to the model.

nextResearchActions: Do not upgrade to High-priority selection based on later returns.
